I need to report an emergency
I work for the response team

text:
DR
Disaster Rescue
Emergency hotline (placeholder)

Emergency reporting for residents and response teams

Disaster Rescue Reporting and Monitoring System

Report an emergency, track the response, and see how the community is affected.

Residents

I need to report an emergency

Use the mobile app to report with photos and location, and to follow the status.

Get the resident app

Response team

I work for the response team

Dispatchers, responders, and the DMO sign in to the staff web.

Sign in to the staff web

Submitting a report through this app does not automatically guarantee immediate rescue. If you are in danger, call your local emergency hotline.

How a report moves
Submitted
Verified
Assigned
In progress
Resolved
Closed

Every status change is recorded, so staff and the resident can see what happened and when.

Who it is for
Residents

Report an emergency with photos and location, and follow its status.

Dispatchers

Verify, prioritize, and assign reports.

Responders

Acknowledge assignments and post rescue updates.

DMO

Monitor trends and export summaries.

The resident app

Residents can report an emergency, add photos and location, and follow each report until it is closed.

Not published yet. Ask your team lead for the demo build.

Privacy

Privacy notice (pending review).
